normalization_plan.reason: _beneficiary is the input address of Slot.buyTicketsFor and carries no independent semantics.
numberOfTickets is a derived count passed straight into addParticipant.
change is the exact value moved by the msg.sender.transfer unsafe operation.
_participant is only used to populate the participants mapping inside addParticipant.
_numberOfTickets is only the loop bound of addParticipant.
Loop index i exists solely to iterate registrations inside addParticipant.
winnerIndex is the local winner selector used only by awardPrizes.
jackpotNumber is only consumed to decide the distributeJackpot branch.
_winnerIndex is the sole address selector parameter of distributeJackpot.
amount is a trivial cache of jackpotAmount inside distributeJackpot.
_size is the loop bound of refundGameAfterLongInactivity.
_fundAddress is only the initial fund argument of the Slot constructor.
_newTicket is only assigned to the ticket variable in changeTicket.
_newFund is only assigned to the fund variable in changeFund.
_newOwner is only forwarded to the ticket contract in changeTicketOwner.
